Three truths in one arc, each measured before fixed.

THE TIER: SYNTAX's own law (|> is never optional on a chain) becomes a
read the medium makes about any source: a let-bound name consumed
exactly once, by exactly the following statement, is a |> stage written
as a binding; runs of two or more report as the audit's verb-shape
line. The verb is a projection of use edges — a twice-used name is <|
territory and never fires, a single step is the law's own exception,
and the counting walks the one total child projection, never a text
scan. The dig convicted a latent class: all three LetStmt mints alias
the ABSENT annotation to the value node (the parser's no-fresh-mint
sentinel), and stmt_child_handles listed both channels — every counting
walk through an unannotated let double-visited its value subtree
(count_var_uses answered 2 for one occurrence; the boolean walks had
masked it). The channel now contributes a child only when it IS an
annotation, and the Stmt decl's comment, which claimed LitUnit absence,
is trued to the artifact.

THE VOICE FIXES the tier's first runs convicted: show_list rendered
last-first — every rendered list in the medium's voice was reversed,
function params and tuple elements in show_type included (map's
declared (f, xs) rendered (xs, f)) — first-first now, zero banked faces
flipped; and severance claimed Alloc severable on rows visibly carrying

the absorption argument, demonstrated inside its own commit.

mentl/7027f60:
The seed emitted six per-family unaligned bump sequences (sst_ 2535,
variant_ 1770, __hstate_ ~235, tuple_ 464, state_tmp 791, record_ 51,
f64box ~30 — ~5996 inline instruction groups) while the one aligned
$alloc existed as a canned data chunk. The handoff called $emit_alloc /
$emit_alloc_dyn dormant; wrong — they are the shared emitter primitives
with 13 callers between them, so converting their three bodies converted
the whole category in one cut. Every site now emits call $alloc; the
$ec_emit_global_get/set_heap_ptr and $ec_emit_i32_add text spellers are
deleted (grep-zero); $emit_alloc_runtime_fn plants the aligned
(size+7)&-8 body once in the module preamble. The wheel mirrors the same
form: the emit_memory_bump / arena / atomic_cas arms and the inline
handler-entry and sst paths all emit call $alloc, and emit_memory_decl
emits the $alloc body itself, so m3 inherits one allocator. m2 now holds
exactly two heap_ptr writers: the live $alloc and the data-string that
emits m3's. All allocations 8-byte aligned (proven behavior-preserving by
the m2.align2 surgical-mask A/B); m2.wasm shrinks 32160 bytes.

Two structural variants were built, disproven, and reverted, each pinning
the ev-slot seam rather than this band: routing the wheel's body-swap
through a new EmitMemory perform left the new op's evidence unplaced (the
strict ev_perform_entry trap fired, backtrace at emit_memory_decl), and
factoring the arm call sites into a shared fn threaded WatOut evidence
across the fn boundary (match-adt regressed). Both confirm PLAN §7's
row-delta fragility; the per-strategy body-swap is the named peer
Hβ.emit.memory-strategy-body-swap, gated on the seam close. The wheel
change is zero-structure: ops, handlers, and installs untouched.

mentl/70db52c:
The Rust bootstrap lexer treated 'own', 'ref', 'gc' as keyword tokens,
which prevented the self-hosted compiler from loading std/compiler/own.lux
(the ownership module uses 'own' as a regular identifier value).

Changes:
- lexer.rs: own/ref/gc now lex as Ident('own'), Ident('ref'), Ident('gc')
- token.rs: removed Own/Ref/Gc enum variants (dead code)
- parser/items.rs: parse_param checks for ownership annotations
  via matches!(peek(), Ident(s) if s == 'own') instead of TokenKind::Own

This unblocks the self-hosted pipeline: `lux check` can now boot
the full compiler pipeline including the ownership module.

Also adds examples/validate_infer.lux for type rule validation.
noodles/70c3c20:
The File panel takes a MIDI file straight from the phone — sniffed by
header, not extension, because downloads rename freely. src/midi.js is a
port of woodshed's converter and becomes the canonical implementation;
the woodshed CLI shims it, so the app and the tool cannot drift apart.

Parts fold onto the four tracks with every merge named. Drums map to the
six voices; percussion without an obvious home — shakers, rides, crashes,
tambourines — is placed by trying each lane and keeping the assignment
that loses the fewest hits. Timbre proposes, the count disposes: on the
house reference the ride's 128 strikes share the open lane with zero
collisions, which no timbre rule would have risked. Scenes that change
chords mid-bar import at harmonyRate 2; anticipations are decided by
sustain across the barline. Swing is measured per track from where the
offbeat 16ths sit.

After import the status line gives the fidelity number and a ledger lists
what the grid could not hold, line by line. The references land at 99.7%
(two side-stick ghosts share the snare's step) and 100%. Neither number
is a claim about how they sound; that check needs ears.

Also in main: the groove slider reaches the engine's designed ceiling of
1.0 (hard-swung sources no longer import straighter than they play), and
the harmony editor gains the 1/bar-2/bar toggle — doubling slots on the
way in, keeping firsts on the way out, so nothing the player wrote moves.

Buffer views are respected (a Node Buffer's .buffer is a pooled slab), so
the same module runs in the app and under node for the CLI and tests.
copycats/7076e7f:
The sim (game/sim/) is pure integer math: Q16.16 subunits per tile,
fixed 60Hz ticks, xorshift32 RNG, no engine physics. A run's replay is
its input log with strict SIM_VERSION matching and no migrations;
ghosts are input logs re-simulated against the level as recorded.

The shell (game/render/) draws sim state and feeds it input bytes:
floating-stick and tap-jump touch zones, drag placement, synthesized
audio, gruvbox palette with blue/orange semantics and shape-coded
hazards for deuteranopia.

Headless suites: unit checks on feel and scoring, three determinism
gates (checksum trail, resim equals live, golden replay 2004298441),
and a flow test that drives the real scene with synthetic touch events
and a farmed finishing run.

index.html is the original single-file browser spike, kept as the feel
reference. DESIGN.md holds the full form this builds toward.
